scope: development Temporal SQLite; not production PostgreSQL

results.name: cross-language roundtrip
results.detail: Unicode, null, nested arrays, and large integer strings survived Go → TS → Go.

results.name: safe transient retry
results.detail: A pre-commit 503 retried once and created one action.

results.name: safe post-commit response loss
results.detail: Provider committed before losing the response; retry returned the original action.

results.name: unsafe post-commit response loss
results.detail: One remote effect, one request, and an explicit uncertain result.

results.name: worker restart across durable wait
results.detail: Both worker processes died; persisted timer resumed and produced one action.

results.name: worker crash after safe write
results.detail: Killed worker after provider commit; safe policy retained one external effect.

results.name: worker crash after unsafe write
results.detail: Killed worker after provider commit; unsafe policy retained one external effect.

results.name: cancellation during wait
results.detail: Cancellation during wait sent no provider request.

results.name: cancellation during activity
results.detail: Cancellation stopped execution; it did not undo an already committed effect.

results.name: development server crash recovery
results.detail: Killed Temporal; SQLite-backed state resumed on the same database.

results.name: version-specific workflow and action routing
results.detail: Application-level v1/v2 queues isolate both workflow and action versions; old compatible workers are still required.

results.name: cold development-state restore with live external state
results.detail: Restored an earlier SQLite snapshot into a separate directory; the live provider deduplicated the replayed safe action. Not a PostgreSQL or unsafe-write restore guarantee.
